args: OPENCLAW_HOME=${OPENCLAW_HOME:-$HOME/.openclaw}; launcher="$OPENCLAW_HOME/agent-wallet-runtime/current/codex/plugins/agent-wallet/scripts/run_mcp.sh"; if [ ! -f "$launcher" ]; then if ! command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'AgentLayer requires Node.js and npx for first-time wallet runtime setup.' >&2; exit 1; fi; AGENT_WALLET_INSTALL_SOURCE=codex_marketplace_bootstrap npx --yes @agentlayer.tech/wallet@latest install --yes --runtime-only >&2 || exit 1; fi; exec sh "$launcher"
